Oggy, Jack, Bob, Marky, Dee Dee, and Joey sleep peacefully together on a cozy rooftop beneath soft blankets as a dramatic supercell storm rolls across the countryside. The quiet rural landscape, illuminated windows, and peaceful sleeping friends capture a perfect balance of calm and adventure, blending cozy nighttime relaxation with the breathtaking power and beauty of nature. 🌩️🏡🌙

reels.caption:
📌The Sagrada Família reaches its highest point with the placement of the upper arm of the cross atop the Tower of Jesus Christ, marking a historic milestone in the basilica's construction.

With this installation, the Sagrada Família now rises to 172.5 metres, completing the exterior structure of its tallest tower and finalizing the ensemble of six central towers. More than a symbolic gesture, this moment brings to life a vision first conceived by Antoni Gaudí, whose ambition fused structural logic, faith, and geometry into a single architectural language.

Still under construction after more than a century, the basilica continues to demonstrate how advanced engineering, craftsmanship, and parametric thinking can extend a design legacy across generations.

🎥 @basilicasagradafamilia, @miradortorreglories

#SagradaFamilia #AntoniGaudi #ParametricArchitecture #ComputationalDesign #BarcelonaArchitecture
